text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan

(Persimpangan Bertingkat Bandar Ainsdale) 2015.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 10 Julai 2015.

Perisytiharan jalan sebagai jalan Persekutuan

2. (1) Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Persimpangan Bertingkat Bandar

Ainsdale yang merupakan sebahagian daripada Lebuh Raya Utara Selatan bermula

di kilometer 267.160 di koordinat U 101875.018, T 93966.358 Grid Rectified Skew

Orthomorphic (RSO) Geosentrik (GDM 2000) dan berakhir di kilometer 268.470

di koordinat U 102407.818, T 92721.886, Grid RSO Geosentrik (GDM 2000) Lebuh Raya

Utara Selatan, kedua-dua jarak diukur dari kilometer 0.0 Lebuh Raya Utara-Selatan

di Persimpangan Bertingkat Johor Bahru, termasuklah Plaza Tol Masuk/Keluar Bandar

Ainsdale dan jalan sambungannya dan berakhir di koordinat U 100607.272,

T 93853.041, Grid RSO Geosentrik (GDM 2000), diisytiharkan sebagai

jalan Persekutuan.

 (2) Jalan yang diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan di bawah

subperenggan (1) ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual.

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (BANDAR AINSDALE INTERCHANGE) ORDER 2015

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Federal Roads Act 1959

[Act 376], the Minister, after consultation with the State Government of

Negeri Sembilan, makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Bandar Ainsdale

Interchange) Order 2015.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 10 July 2015.

Declaration of road to be Federal road

2. (1) The part of the road known as the Bandar Ainsdale Interchange which is a

part of the North South Expressway commencing at kilometre 267.160 at coordinates

N 101875.018, E 93966.358 of the Rectified Skew Orthomorphic (RSO) Geocentric

(GDM 2000) Grid and ending at kilometre 268.470 at coordinates N 102407.818,

E 92721.886 of the RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid of the North South Expressway,

both distances are measured from kilometre 0.0 of the North South Expressway at the

Johore Bahru Interchange, including the Bandar Ainsdale Entry/Exit Toll Plaza and its

link road and ending at coordinates N 100607.272, E 93853.041 of the RSO Geocentric

(GDM 2000) Grid, is declared to be a Federal road.

 (2) The road declared to be a Federal road under subparagraph (1) is shown

on the map in the Schedule.
